errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the smallest sector, 'не' (orange), is located in the top right corner. In fact, the orange sector is at the bottom right, while the blue sector ('не мога да преценя') is in the top right.
The description uses the awkward and repetitive phrase 'синьо-синьо' (blue-blue) to describe the blue sector. 'синьо' (blue) would be sufficient.
